newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian PM apologises for "stolen generation".
newsitem.headline: Australian PM apologises for "stolen generation".

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard made an unexpected personal apology on Monday to tens of thousands of Aborigines who were forcibly removed from their parents under a government policy of assimilation.
"I am sorry for the hurt, the trauma, many here today continue to feel as a consequence of those practices," Howard told a major conference on Aboriginal reconciliation.
